Once upon a time, there was a young hero named Cloud Leap, who grew up alongside a girl named Qingfeng, their childhood friendship blossoming into secret affection.
Yet as turmoil swept the land, Cloud Leap left Ink City for the rivers and lakes, seeking to right the world's wrongs.
Thus parted by fate, their only connection was a wooden kite named "Cloud Drift," carrying messages of love across the distance.

Each time Qingfeng saw the kite, she knew Cloud Leap's heart remained true.
But fate proved cruel—Qingfeng succumbed to illness, their love left unfulfilled.
A year later, Cloud Leap too met his end, struck down by villains while saving a child, as if following his beloved beyond.

With no home to return to, "Cloud Drift" wandered the skies, carried by the wind.
Through seasons and across mountains, it somehow found its way to Qingfeng's grave.
Suddenly, the lonely tomb shimmered with golden light!
From within emerged another wooden kite—"Wind Dance."

Though meeting for the first time, the two kites reunited like old friends, their bond unbreakable, defying all storms.
Blessed by the gods before the Matchmaker's Temple, they transformed into a pair of living Twin Swallows.
Now, though time has its price and life its end, they soar wing-to-wing, hearts forever entwined.
